{{Quote|General Tiin, the ship is lost."<br />"Then it's time we get a new one.|A [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Impavid)|clone commander]] and Saesee Tiin|<ref name="CW23" />}}
The '''''Prosperous''''' was a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the ''Prosperous'' took part in the Confederacy's surprise [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] capitol [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The ''Prosperous'' and the rest of the Separatist [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] arrived out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] over Coruscant and began to assault the Republic's [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|defense forces]]. However, during the battle, the ''Prosperous'' was boarded by the hundreds of Republic [[clone marine]]s led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], who were escaping their own damaged [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Impavid/Legends|Impavid]]''. [[General/Legends|General]] Tiin and his marines fought their way inside the ''Prosperous'', defeated the [[Carrier/Legends|carrier's]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] crew, and captured the Separatist vessel.

==Description==
[[File:ImpavidProsperous-CW23.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Impavid'' releases its clone marines while it passes the ''Prosperous''.]]
The ''Prosperous'' was a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]<ref name="db">{{DB|character|saeseetiin|Tiin, Saesee}}</ref>&mdash;manufactured by the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]]<ref name="TCWCG" />&mdash;serving in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The ''Prosperous'' had a heavily automated control system,<ref name="db" /> which included several offensive [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] turrets positioned across its [[Hull/Legends|hull]], which were operated by several consoles on the [[Carrier/Legends|carrier's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] at the front of the ship.<ref name="CW23" />

==History==
{{Quote|Prepare to board!|General Tiin before capturing the ''Prosperous''|<ref name="CW23" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the ''Prosperous''<ref name="db" /> was part of the large Confederate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attacked]] the Republic's capital [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], hoping to kidnap Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The ''Prosperous'' and the rest of the Separatist navy arrived out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] over Coruscant, and began to engage the Republic's [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|defense fleet]]. However, during the battle, the Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Impavid/Legends|Impavid]]'' was badly damaged. [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]&mdash;who had taken over command of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] during the invasion&mdash;ordered the ''Impavid''{{'s}} [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] crew to pass over the nearby ''Prosperous'' and abandon the dying vessel.<ref name="CW23" />

Firing its turbolasers at the carrier, the ''Impavid'' flew over the ''Prosperous'', while [[General/Legends|General]] Tiin and hundreds of highly trained [[clone marine]]s donned pressurized [[Environment suit/Legends|space armor]], and jumped out of the ''Impavid''{{'s}} port-side [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. Floating through the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] between the two [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyers]], Tiin and his [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] landed on the ''Prosperous''{{'s}} hull and began to fight their way inside the Separatist capital ship. The ''Prosperous''{{'s}} own turbolasers held back most of the clone boarders on the ship's hull, [[Death/Legends|killing]] many of the marines. However, Tiin and a few marines managed to get aboard the ''Prosperous'' via a hole Tiin had cut in the ship's hull with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="CW23" />

[[File:Saeseewheel.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Saesee Tiin at the helm of the ''Prosperous'']]
Mowing their way through the ''Prosperous''{{'s}} [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] crew, Tiin and his infiltrators reached the bridge, where the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] took the helm of the carrier. Using the different consoles on the bridge, Tiin redirected the ''Prosperous''{{'s}} turret fire from the clone marines still stuck on the hull to other nearby Separatist [[Warship/Legends|warships]], with the marines on the hull cheering as they realized that the Republic had captured the vessel.<ref name="CW23" /> Because of the high level of automation across the carrier, Tiin and his marines secured the rest of the ''Prosperous'' with relative ease,<ref name="db" /> and returned to Coruscant aboard the ''Prosperous'' after the battle.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Commanders and crew==
During its service in the Confederate Navy, the ''Prosperous'' was crewed and guarded by several B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. However, these battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were no match for General Tiin and his elite clone marines, who boarded and seized the ''Prosperous''. After the Republic captured the ''Prosperous'', Tiin took command of the carrier during the Battle of Coruscant.<ref name="CW23" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Prosperous'' was first shown as an unnamed ''Providence''-class carrier in "[[Chapter 23 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|Chapter 23]]" of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' animated series]], first airing [[March 23]], [[2005]]. The ''Prosperous'' was later identified on Saesee Tiin's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on [[StarWars.com]].
